name: How long does carpet installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does carpet installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of carpet installation depends on the size and complexity of the area. A typical residential room might take a few hours, while multiple rooms or an entire house could require one to two days. Factors like furniture removal, existing flooring demolition, and intricate layouts can also extend the timeline. Our team provides an estimated timeline during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpet installation time varies, from a few hours for a single room to one to two days for an entire house, depending on complexity.
